scenes.title: Grouping 40 binary 0-and-1 tiles into crisp 3-digit octal chunks on the Harvard seminar table

layout.description: Sunlit 1956 wood-paneled Harvard seminar room with a green slate chalkboard and a long oak table covered in small white wooden tiles printed with black 0s and 1s alongside larger bracketed octal summary blocks.

positions.who: George A. Miller (mannequin in 1950s tweed jacket, white shirt, and dark tie)
positions.where: standing at the oak table sliding loose 0-1-1 tiles into neat three-tile wooden brackets

positions.who: Sidney Smith (mannequin in rolled Oxford sleeves)
positions.where: standing beside the chalkboard reciting 40 binary digits effortlessly from his octal chunk brackets

props.name: loose binary 0/1 tile row
props.period_detail: 40 individual white tiles printed with 0 or 1 where an ungrouped subject stalls after tile 9
props.physical_behavior: swept cleanly into neat triplets like [1 0 1] -> [5]

props.name: octal chunking brackets
props.period_detail: carved wooden 3-tile trays labeled with single octal digits 0 through 7
props.physical_behavior: compresses 21 binary tiles into just 7 manageable chunks

props.name: chalkboard span comparison chart
props.period_detail: crisp white chalk bars comparing binary digits, decimal digits, letters, and words all hovering near height 7
props.physical_behavior: shows bits skyrocket while chunk count stays flat near seven

actions.verb_sequence: attempts to recall loose binary tiles and stalls at tile 9 -> slides wooden 3-tile octal brackets over the line -> recites all 40 binary digits cleanly
draws a horizontal chalk line across '7 ± 2 chunks' on the slate board

reactions.reaction: taps the final 40th tile with effortless precision
gestures between the tiny 9-bit binary stack and tall 70-bit word stack fitting inside the same seven-slot tray

scenes.wardrobe: 1956 Ivy League academic attire: brown herringbone tweed jacket, Oxford button-down shirts, narrow knit ties, khaki and wool trousers.
scenes.lighting: High-key New England window daylight across green slate chalkboard and oak tabletop.
scenes.recognition_hook: Stalling after just nine raw zeros and ones, a Harvard researcher groups every three digits into one octal chunk and recalls forty straight without a mistake.

key_visual.description: two 1950s Harvard researchers at an oak table grouping scattered 0-and-1 tiles into neat three-tile wooden brackets beneath a '7 ± 2' chalkboard chart

scenes.title: Seven binary digits versus seven rich English words

layout.description: Split tabletop display comparing seven thin binary cards on the left with seven thick dictionary word cards on the right.

positions.where: reading back seven English word cards effortlessly

props.name: seven binary cards vs seven word cards
props.physical_behavior: both sets fill seven wooden slots despite a tenfold difference in information bits

actions.verb_sequence: places seven thick word cards into the exact same seven-slot wooden rack

reactions.reaction: points out that slot count, not bit weight, sets the bottleneck

scenes.recognition_hook: Seven words carry ten times more bits than seven zeros, yet fit the same mental rack.

scenes.title: Unidimensional tone judgment ceiling around six categories

layout.description: Clean acoustic testing desk with an oscillator frequency dial and numbered response buttons 1 through 10.

positions.where: pressing numbered category buttons as pure tones play

props.name: ten-button pitch judgment box
props.physical_behavior: accuracy stays crisp up to 6 tones then blurs when stretched to 10

actions.verb_sequence: identifies four tones flawlessly -> hesitates when ten ungrouped pitches are mixed

scenes.recognition_hook: Without a reference scale, raw one-dimensional pitch judgment tops out around six categories.

scenes.title: Chunking a messy modern task list into three clear buckets

layout.description: Sunlit white desk where twelve scattered sticky notes are reorganized into three clean labeled columns.

positions.where: grouping twelve loose notes under three bold category headers

props.name: three-column whiteboard
props.period_detail: clean board grouping twelve tasks into three clear 4-item chunks
props.physical_behavior: turns cognitive overload into instant clarity

actions.verb_sequence: clusters loose notes into three named buckets

scenes.recognition_hook: Bundling twelve scattered tasks into three named buckets works WITH your prefrontal slots.
